Discover the Technology Driving Our Intelligence Solutions Cyberglobes Modules Wide Search Profiler Darkweb IP Location Mass Profiler Facia Recognition User Search AI Case M. Avatar Blender RSS Alert Wide Social Search Module Allows users to define geographical areas of interest on a map and receive real-time social media activity within those boundaries. It provides invaluable insights into evolving social trends, topical discussions, and keywords, making it indispensable for monitoring the digital landscape. Targeted Profiler Module The Profiler uncovers public details about specific social media accounts, using advanced AI analysis and hundreds of data sources, a professional information is uncover and facilitating a deeper understanding of individuals . Deep & Dark Web Search Module Dedicated to collecting Dark Web activities and content, covertly exposing criminal activities, this module reveals additional details associated with a target, that were previously unattainable with normal search engines like google or bing. IP Geolocation Module Using Instant Messaging Applications, we can retrieve IP addresses, which can help us estimate the geolocation of individuals at the country or city level. Particularly valuable when a target is using a burner phone without a simcard. Unknown User Search Module The User Search module allows investigators to uncover individuals using non-unique identifiers such as names. By leveraging sophisticated algorithms and extensive databases, this tool can help pinpoint specific individuals even with limited initial information on many different social media platforms. Cyberglobes AI Fusion Module Our on-premises AI tool is specifically designed for intelligence investigations, analyses large volumes of data, extracting key insights and connections that might be missed by human analysts. Case Manager Module The Case Manager module serves as a central hub for organizing investigations. It allows analysts to save profiles, searches, and other relevant data within specific cases, providing a structured and efficient way to manage complex, ongoing investigations. Avatar Storage Manager Module The Avatar Manager is a specialized tool for maintaining and organizing virtual identities, or "sock puppets". This module enables law enforcement to securely manage multiple online personas for covert investigations and virtual infiltration operations. Blender Analytics Module The Blender module provides sophisticated graph-based analytics capabilities. It allows for virtual link analysis of any group, profile, or entity, helping investigators visualize and understand complex networks and relationships within the data. RSS - News Collection Module Gathering information from multiple online sources it aggregates content from various RSS feeds, news outlets, and websites, providing a centralized hub for tracking and filtering relevant intelligence. Helping to identify emerging trends or threats. Real Time Social Media ALERT Module The Alert module provides real-time monitoring capabilities for critical intelligence. It allows analysts to set up customized notifications based on keywords, geography, or user activities across various social media platforms. Ensuring timely awareness of emerging threats. Mass Profiler Module Enabling bulk uploads and enrichment of multiple profiles simultaneously. This increases efficiency of large-scale investigations, allowing law enforcement and intelligence agencies to process and analyse vast amounts of profiles in a single operation. S.M. Facial Recognition Module We employ AI to identify individuals based on image data by scanning large proprietary scrapped databases of social media and website images to find matches. Providing crucial capabilities for identifying persons of interest across various sources. System Capabilites ADVANCED IMAGE ANALYSIS Our system boasts advanced image analysis, including Optical Character Recognition, Automatic Face Detection, and Image Entity Extraction. From extracting text from images to identifying objects such as glasses, hats, and cars, our tools equip you with a deeper understanding of visual content. VISUALIZE RESULTS Experience a visually engaging interface that presents activity timelines, pie charts, and Visual Entity Relationship Graphs (VLN) to display relationships and connections. This intuitive visualization helps you interpret complex data effortlessly and aids in building a comprehensive understanding of criminal networks. NAMED-ENTITY RECOGNITION Named-Entity Recognition (NER) is a fundamental aspect of natural language processing (NLP) that plays a crucial role in deciphering the vast amounts of unstructured text data generated daily.
